insights.summary: The agent successfully implemented a complex set of CUDA and C++ changes to support strided RMS norm and fused quantization. It correctly identified the architectural needs for MLA-based models. However, it skipped the critical step of verifying the performance gains through execution, likely due to the complexity of rebuilding the repository.
strengths: Strong understanding of the C++/PyTorch interface layer.
Accurate identification of the 'stride' optimization pattern.
weaknesses: Failed to verify changes with actual execution.
Did not complete the 'last mile' of integrating the new kernels into the Python model layers.
